how_to_apply: There is no online application for this recruitment. Interested and eligible candidates must appear in person for a walk-in interview at the specified date, time and venue with the following documents:
Name of the post applied for
Candidate's full name and address, with mobile number, phone number and email ID (a mobile number is mandatory)
Date of birth proof (school leaving certificate/birth certificate/SSC record)
Educational qualification documents and mark sheets of the qualifying year(s)
Experience certificates from Government/Semi-Government departments, where applicable
SSC mark sheet, HSC mark sheet, and mark sheets/certificates of the qualifying year where the post requires a specific qualification
Mark sheets of higher educational qualification, if held
Government ITI certificate and other required certificates (attested copies)
Venue: Manpa Mukhyalaya (Municipal Corporation Headquarters), opposite Killa, Malegaon.
No travelling allowance or any other allowance will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Malegaon Municipal Corporation Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Malegaon Municipal Corporation has officially released the recruitment notification for the appointment of 63 candidates against 18 medical and paramedical posts at N.N. Wadia Hospital under Malegaon Municipal Corporation. The notification includes complete details on post-wise vacancies, educational qualifications, experience requirements, age limits, monthly honorarium, interview dates and timings, selection process, required documents and terms and conditions of temporary appointment. Candidates are strongly advised to read the full notification before appearing for the walk-in interview. Download Malegaon Municipal Corporation Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF Official website

content_sections.heading: Malegaon Municipal Corporation Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria and Qualification
content_sections.text: Eligibility is specific to each post and combines an educational qualification, relevant work experience, and, for nursing/medical posts, council registration. The table below summarises the qualification and experience required for each post as stated in the notification. Candidates should note that the minimum educational qualification for each post must strictly match column 4 of the official notification; the notification does not state that any relaxation applies to the qualification requirement itself.

rows.educational_qualification: MD (Medicine) or equivalent degree from a recognised university
MD (Anaesthesia) or MBBS with DA (Diploma in Anaesthesia) or equivalent
MD/DCH or MD (Pediatric Medicine) or equivalent
MD/DCH/MD (Anatomy), MBBS with DCP (Diploma in Clinical Pathology), or equivalent
MD, or MBBS with DGO (Diploma in Gynaecology & Obstetrics), or equivalent
MBBS or Govt.-recognised equivalent degree from a recognised university
HSC (Science) pass from Maharashtra Board; General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) degree
HSC (Science) pass; GNM degree; Public Health Nursing course certificate
Degree in Chemistry, Biology and Microbiology from a recognised university; DMLT exam passed from a recognised institute
Science degree with Physics from a recognised university; X-ray technician training from a Govt.-recognised institution
12th (Science) pass from Maharashtra Board; GNM degree
HSC (Science) pass; Diploma in Pharmacy (D.Pharm); D.Pharm degree holders preferred
Maharashtra State Secondary/Higher Secondary pass; ANM course from a Govt.-recognised institute
12th pass with Biology (Maharashtra Board, Science stream)
7th class pass; ability to read, write and speak Marathi
7th class pass; ability to read, write and speak Marathi

content_sections.heading: Malegaon Municipal Corporation Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be paid a fixed monthly honorarium (not a regular pay scale), ranging from ₹11,000 to ₹80,000 depending on the post, as shown in the vacancy details table above. As per government policy, EPF and ESIC contributions will be deducted from the honorarium where applicable.

content_sections.heading: Malegaon Municipal Corporation Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is made through the following process, as stated in the notification: Scrutiny of candidates' certificates and documents Only candidates found eligible after document scrutiny will be called for a walk-in interview; ineligible candidates will not be considered for interview Preference will be given to candidates with experience in a local self-government body and to those who have actual COVID-19 period work experience, as well as to local candidates

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Malegaon Municipal Corporation Recruitment 2026 (Walk-in Interview)
content_sections.text: There is no online application for this recruitment. Interested and eligible candidates must appear in person for a walk-in interview at the specified date, time and venue with the following documents: Name of the post applied for Candidate's full name and address, with mobile number, phone number and email ID (a mobile number is mandatory) Date of birth proof (school leaving certificate/birth certificate/SSC record) Educational qualification documents and mark sheets of the qualifying year(s) Experience certificates from Government/Semi-Government departments, where applicable SSC mark sheet, HSC mark sheet, and mark sheets/certificates of the qualifying year where the post requires a specific qualification Mark sheets of higher educational qualification, if held Government ITI certificate and other required certificates (attested copies) Passport-size photograph Venue: Manpa Mukhyalaya (Municipal Corporation Headquarters), opposite Killa, Malegaon. No travelling allowance or any other allowance will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Terms and Conditions
content_sections.text: These posts are for a maximum period of six months on a lump-sum honorarium basis; the appointment ends automatically on completion of the period, and no separate termination order will be issued The Commissioner, Malegaon Municipal Corporation, holds full rights over the recruitment process, including the right to cancel or postpone the process at any stage, change the number of posts, alter terms and conditions, change the place of posting, and increase or decrease the honorarium These are temporary, specific-duration posts created only to manage current work requirements; selected candidates will have no claim to permanent employment or regularisation If a selected candidate's work performance during the honorarium period is found unsatisfactory, the engagement can be terminated immediately without prior notice The recruitment process is intended to be transparent, and candidates are cautioned against falling prey to any fraudulent practices related to it Any candidate found to be exerting direct or indirect pressure to secure appointment under this recruitment will be disqualified from the process

faq.question: Q1. What is Malegaon Mahanagarpalika Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by Malegaon Mahanagarpalika (Malegaon Municipal Corporation) to fill 63 posts across 18 medical and paramedical roles on a lump-sum honorarium basis for six months, to operationalise the newly constructed N.N. Wadia Hospital.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Malegaon Mahanagarpalika Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 63 vacancies in total, spread across posts such as Medical Officer (MBBS and BAMS), Specialist Doctors, Staff Nurse, ANM, Lab Technician, X-Ray Technician, Ward Attendants and other support roles.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Malegaon Mahanagarpalika Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application deadline mentioned, since this is a walk-in interview process rather than an online application. Interviews are scheduled on 7 and 8 September 2026, post-wise.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Malegaon Mahanagarpalika Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification requirements differ by post, ranging from a 7th class pass for Ward Attendant posts to postgraduate medical degrees (MD) for specialist doctor posts. See the eligibility table above for post-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Malegaon Mahanagarpalika Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The general age limit is 18 to 38 years, and 18 to 43 years for backward class candidates. Medical Officers who served during COVID-19 and other emergency periods are exempt from the maximum age limit.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for Malegaon Mahanagarpalika Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is not specified in the notification, as this is a walk-in interview process with no online application or fee payment step mentioned.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for Malegaon Mahanagarpalika Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no online application. Eligible candidates must attend the walk-in interview in person at the Manpa Mukhyalaya, opposite Killa, Malegaon, with all required original and attested documents, on the date and time allotted to their post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Malegaon Mahanagarpalika Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on document scrutiny followed by a walk-in interview. Only candidates found eligible after scrutiny are interviewed; preference is given to candidates with local self-government or COVID-19 period work experience and to local candidates.
